Yes, I'm certainly aware of the Recharge Mode/Omni Cannon strategy.   I have a few things to say about this.

 

Firstly, it can be very effective.  Omni Cannon does a lot of damage, for sure.  Against Villains with not a lot of Stuff destruction this can be very good,  but above all else you can not lose the Omni Cannon once you've spent time charging it.  So you either have to be against the right  Villain and make sure that doesn't happen, or rely on your team to have enough of a buffer to keep the Cannon alive.

 

Secondly, this relies on getting Omni Cannon very very quickly.   In your opening draw is best,  in your first couple its still viable.   There are only 2 Omni-Cannons in his deck, so while this occaisionally works out,   a lot of the time it doesn't.  Thirdly  I don't personally feel its especially fun.   You take damage, you sit in turtle mode and drop 3 cards under your cannon for your turn.  I'm not impressed.   What I guess I primarily meant is that it would be cool if bunker switched modes more.   Both the Recharge/Omni-Cannon and Turret Mode +any 2 powers strategy relies on basically one mode the whole game.   There is little incentive to jump from one mode to the next to the next.

 

Ammo Drop is not particularly critical to a Turret Mode strategy unless you are using Gatling or Omni-Cannon as one of your powers.  Otherwise you simply maintain your hand size.  Anyway, my point is while I acknowledge the viability (at least some of the time) of a recharge mode/omni-cannon strategy,  it doesn't seem to be Bunker's primary attack route.
